warning: MODEL-DEPENDENT VIRTUAL PERTURBATION - NOT CAUSALLY VALIDATED. No result establishes a bifurcation, a causal intervention, whole-brain dynamics, or a biological validation.

G1.criterion: selected model, seed 17, 5/5 worms, finite fraction >= 0.95
G1.notes: Free-running rollouts are finite and start from the observed initial state; no future teacher forcing.

G2.criterion: mean delta R2 >= 0.02, seed-17 block-bootstrap CI > 0, mean h5 MSE <= persistence, in >=4/5 worms
G2.notes: Selected model is chosen on validation one-step R2. It fails the free-running dynamical-advantage gate in all five worms; the best descriptive model (VAR) beats the constant-state baseline but was not selected by that criterion.

G3.criterion: mean TV(sim, observed) at least 0.02 lower than both constant-state persistence and the outcome-marginal null, and simulated entropy inside the observed 95% event range, in >=3/5 worms
G3.notes: Simulated outcome distributions are not closer to observed reversal-conditioned distributions than persistence or the outcome-marginal null. Several block-null tests show an observed entropy DEFICIT, not excess. No bifurcation is claimed.

G4.criterion: A named predictor neuron can be selected, perturbed under an explicit protocol, and its model-dependent trajectory/outcome effects reported with controls.
G4.notes: Functional interface only; passing does not validate a biological intervention.

G5.criterion: at least one named-neuron direction has mean |delta TV| above the random-neuron 95th percentile, agrees in sign in >=4/5 worms, and agrees in >=2/3 model seeds
G5.notes: No candidate exceeds the random-neuron 95th percentile. Top TV effects are not robust across worms or model seeds, and >98% of perturbed states are outside training support. Initial-state probes move trajectories without changing outcomes.

G6.criterion: A matched empirical stimulation-response dataset and a held-out causal effect must be available.
G6.notes: Kato 2015 is observational. No optogenetic/histamine response model is registered. Category C empirical_response is therefore refused by the code.
